spec.title: Kamiwaza · Application API & Web Interface
spec.description: Are the application workloads up, erroring, or short of resources?

spec.title: Error lines
spec.description: Error-level lines per second by workload, compared with the day before

spec.title: Warning lines
spec.description: Warning-level lines per second by workload

spec.title: CPU, % of limit
spec.description: Busiest replica of each container, as a share of its CPU limit

spec.expr: 100 * max by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name, container) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", resource="cpu"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name=~"core-api|core-retrieval-streamer|dataplane|frontend"}))

spec.title: Memory, % of limit
spec.description: Largest replica of each container, as a share of its memory limit

spec.expr: 100 * max by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name, container) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", resource="memory"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name=~"core-api|core-retrieval-streamer|dataplane|frontend"}))

spec.title: CPU throttling
spec.description: Share of CFS periods throttled; sustained throttling slows requests

spec.expr: 100 * max by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name, container) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{namespace="$namespace", owner_kind=~"ReplicaSet|StatefulSet|DaemonSet"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name=~"core-api|core-retrieval-streamer|dataplane|frontend"}))

spec.title: Restarts
spec.description: Container restarts over a sliding hour

spec.expr: sum by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name, container) (round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace"}[1h])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name=~"core-api|core-retrieval-streamer|dataplane|frontend"})) > 0

spec.title: Core API errors and warnings
spec.description: Application API log lines at warning level or above

options.content:
**Are the application workloads up, erroring, or short of resources?**

- **Replicas** compares ready with desired for the API, retrieval streamer, protocol data plane, and web interface.
- **Errors** counts error and warning log lines, the only error signal these workloads publish, against the day before.
- **Saturation** shows each container's use of its CPU and memory limits, CPU throttling, and restarts, by workload and container.

Request rate and latency are not shown: the application does not publish Prometheus metrics.
